question: What spiritual status is attained by reciting this armor even a few times?
premises: Recitation may be once, twice, or thrice
It is done according to one's knowledge
The reciter becomes composed of all austerities
inference: Even limited recitation of the armor makes the reciter endowed with all austerities.
plain_english: Whether recited once, twice, or thrice, as one knows it, he becomes filled with all austerities.
